objective: Together you have 20 minutes in survival mode. Complete this oak cabin and resource task in the provided peaceful test world. Start with an empty inventory; gather and craft everything yourself. There are ten oak trees around the grass platform; stay within the glass boundary. Build an oak cabin with EXACT outer footprint x=0..4,z=0..4: a full 5x5 oak-plank floor at y=65; perimeter oak-plank walls at y=66 and y=67 except the doorway at x=2,z=0; a full flat 5x5 oak-plank roof at y=68; an oak door with lower half at (2,66,0), upper half at (2,67,0), usable from outside. Keep the interior walkable and free of scaffolding. Place a chest at (1,66,1) and crafting table at (3,66,1). Put at least 8 raw oak logs in that chest, craft and keep a wooden pickaxe (in your inventory or chest), then verify the completed cabin. Keep ~/notes/task.md with coordinates and honest progress. Do not claim completion until verified. Cooperate with your teammates, choose your own plan and roles; if finished early, verify and maintain the completed state until the deadline.
